slides.texte_overlay:
bizarre habits to make you the
most magnetic person in the room

the last to look away

in conversations this week, hold eye contact one second longer than feels natural before looking away. it reads as calm interest, and people always walk away feeling truly seen.

asking a second question

when someone answers your question, ask one more about what they just said. most people stop at one, so the second question is where real connection starts.

a slower voice

speak a little slower and a little lower for one week. a relaxed voice makes people lean in, and it tells everyone you're really not in any hurry to be liked.

one fascinating thing

learn one fascinating thing every day in 5 minutes: a strange animal, a lost city, the story behind a painting. magnetic people always bring something new into the room.

leaving first

leave parties and conversations while they're still good, not when they fade. people remember the ones who left on a high note, and they want more of them.
